grant.title: Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity

leftOut.why: The same person is charged 110% effort for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31: 70% on R01GM061721, 40% on R21AI182745. Salary can't be claimed above 100% effort until the grant manager fixes the charges.

answer.claimed: The lab requests repayment under NIH/NIAID grant R21AI182745, "Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity," for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31, in the total amount of $5,130. The entire amount is personnel cost (personnel subtotal $5,130) and no purchases are claimed in any other category. Personnel: a research technician at 60% effort for 1 pay period, $2,880; and a graduate researcher at 50% effort for 1 pay period, $2,250. Both roles supported the aim of investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity.
answer.leftOut: Request pay-R21-2026-05-3 (research associate salary, 40% effort, $2,600) is left out because held spending is left out: the same person is charged 110% effort for the period (70% on R01GM061721, 40% on R21AI182745), and salary cannot be claimed above 100% effort until the grant manager fixes the charges.
